entry.name: rnbo_comb~
entry.description: Use the comb~ object to apply the classic comb filtering effect to an audio input. The comb~ object mixes the current input sample with earlier input and/or output samples, according to the formula: yn = axn + bxn-(DR/1000) + cyn-(DR/1000) where R is the sampling rate and D is a delay time in milliseconds.

arguments.name: delayTime
arguments.description: Sets the delay time in ms.
